27: def physicalFourierCLM : SchwartzTensor →L[ℂ] SchwartzTensor :=
28:   (SchwartzMap.compCLMOfContinuousLinearEquiv ℂ physicalFourierArgument).comp
29:     (FourierTransform.fourierInvCLM ℂ SchwartzTensor)
30: 
31: theorem physicalFourier_apply (f : SchwartzTensor) (p : Spacetime) :
32:     physicalFourierCLM f p=(𝓕⁻ f) ((2*Real.pi)⁻¹ • metricFlip p) := rfl
33: 
34: theorem physicalFourier_surjective : Function.Surjective physicalFourierCLM := by
35:   intro g
36:   let h:=SchwartzMap.compCLMOfContinuousLinearEquiv ℂ physicalFourierArgument.symm g
37:   refine ⟨𝓕 h,?_⟩
38:   ext p : 1
39:   change (𝓕⁻ (𝓕 h)) (physicalFourierArgument p)=g p
40:   rw [FourierTransform.fourierInv_fourier_eq]
41:   change g (physicalFourierArgument.symm (physicalFourierArgument p))=g p
42:   rw [ContinuousLinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
43: 
44: def physicalSmearCLM : SchwartzTensor →L[ℂ] H1 := momentumSmearCLM.comp physicalFourierCLM
45: 
46: theorem physicalSmear_ae (f : SchwartzTensor) :
47:     physicalSmearCLM f =ᵐ[ChatgptAudit.WignerRapidityMeasure016.orbitalMeasure 0]
48:       globalCoefficient (physicalFourierCLM f) :=
49:   (globalCoefficient_memLp (physicalFourierCLM f)).coeFn_toLp

66: def physicalField (f : RealTest) : F →ₗ.[ℂ] F := segal (physicalSmearCLM f.val)
67: 
68: theorem physicalField_essentially_selfadjoint (f : RealTest) :

71: theorem physicalField_has_exponential_core (f : RealTest) :

74: theorem physicalField_vacuum (f : RealTest) :
75:     physicalField f ⟨vacuum,vacuum_mem_domain⟩ =
76:       ((Real.sqrt 2)⁻¹ : ℂ) • oneParticle (physicalSmearCLM f.val) := segal_vacuum _

23: /-- The existing circular smearing, now bundled as a continuous linear map. -/
24: def circularSmearCLM : SchwartzTensor →L[ℂ] H1 :=
25:   circularH1.symm.toLinearIsometry.toContinuousLinearMap.comp physicalSmearCLM
26: 
27: theorem circularSmearCLM_apply (f : SchwartzTensor) :
28:     circularSmearCLM f = circularSmear f := rfl
29: 
30: theorem circularH1_circularSmear (f : SchwartzTensor) :
31:     circularH1 (circularSmearCLM f) = physicalSmearCLM f :=
32:   circularH1.apply_symm_apply (physicalSmearCLM f)

90: def circularField (f : RealTest) : F →ₗ.[ℂ] F :=
91:   segal (circularSmearCLM f.val)
92: 
93: theorem circularField_essentially_selfadjoint (f : RealTest) :
94:     IsSelfAdjoint (circularField f).closure := segal_essentially_selfadjoint _
95: 
96: /-- Field equality includes transport of the actual state and operator domain. -/
97: theorem circularField_intertwines (f : RealTest) (x : domain) :
98:     gamma circularH1 (circularField f x) =
99:       physicalField f (domainGamma circularH1 x) := by
100:   have ht := segal_gamma circularH1 (circularSmearCLM f.val) x
101:   rw [circularH1_circularSmear] at ht
102:   exact ht.symm
103: 
104: theorem circularField_intertwines_regular (f : RealTest) (ψ : regularFockDomain) :
105:     gamma circularH1 (circularField f (regularDomainInput ψ)) =
106:       physicalField f (regularDomainInput (regularCircular ψ)) := by
107:   rw [circularField_intertwines, domainGamma_regularCircular]

109: /-- Fixed positive amplitude from the already derived Fourier stress scale. -/
110: def unitaryFourierFieldAmplitude : ℝ := Real.sqrt unitaryFourierStressScale
111: 
112: theorem unitaryFourierFieldAmplitude_pos : 0 < unitaryFourierFieldAmplitude :=
113:   Real.sqrt_pos.mpr unitaryFourierStressScale_pos
114: 
115: theorem unitaryFourierFieldAmplitude_sq :
116:     unitaryFourierFieldAmplitude ^ 2 = unitaryFourierStressScale :=
117:   Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt unitaryFourierStressScale_pos)
118: 
119: def normalizedPhysicalSmearCLM : SchwartzTensor →L[ℂ] H1 :=
120:   (unitaryFourierFieldAmplitude : ℂ) • physicalSmearCLM
121: 
122: def normalizedCircularSmearCLM : SchwartzTensor →L[ℂ] H1 :=
123:   (unitaryFourierFieldAmplitude : ℂ) • circularSmearCLM
124: 
125: theorem circularH1_normalizedCircularSmear (f : SchwartzTensor) :
126:     circularH1 (normalizedCircularSmearCLM f) = normalizedPhysicalSmearCLM f := by
127:   change circularH1 ((unitaryFourierFieldAmplitude : ℂ) • circularSmearCLM f) =
128:     (unitaryFourierFieldAmplitude : ℂ) • physicalSmearCLM f
129:   rw [map_smul, circularH1_circularSmear]

138:     normalizedPhysicalField f x =
139:       (unitaryFourierFieldAmplitude : ℂ) • physicalField f x :=
140:   segal_parameter_real_smul unitaryFourierFieldAmplitude (physicalSmearCLM f.val) x

142: theorem normalizedCircularField_essentially_selfadjoint (f : RealTest) :

145: theorem normalizedCircularField_intertwines_regular (f : RealTest) (ψ : regularFockDomain) :
146:     gamma circularH1 (normalizedCircularField f (regularDomainInput ψ)) =
147:       normalizedPhysicalField f (regularDomainInput (regularCircular ψ)) := by
148:   have ht := segal_gamma circularH1 (normalizedCircularSmearCLM f.val) (regularDomainInput ψ)
149:   rw [circularH1_normalizedCircularSmear, domainGamma_regularCircular] at ht

14: theorem circularSmear_ae (f : SchwartzTensor) :
15:     circularSmear f =ᵐ[orbitalMeasure 0] fun p =>
16:       circularFiber.symm (globalCoefficient (physicalFourierCLM f) p) := by
17:   have he : circularH1 (circularSmear f)=physicalSmearCLM f :=
18:     circularH1.apply_symm_apply _
19:   filter_upwards [fiberLiftMap_ae circularFiber (circularSmear f),physicalSmear_ae f] with p hp hf
20:   have hv := congrArg (fun v : H1 => v p) he
21:   change fiberLiftMap circularFiber (circularSmear f) p=physicalSmearCLM f p at hv
22:   rw [hp,hf] at hv
23:   exact circularFiber.injective (by rw [hv,circularFiber.apply_symm_apply])
24: 
25: theorem circularSmear_rapidity_ae (f : SchwartzTensor) :
26:     toRapidity (circularSmear f) =ᵐ[momentumMeasure] fun y =>
27:       circularFiber.symm (globalCoefficient (physicalFourierCLM f) (rapidityChart 0 y)) := by
28:   have hc := (rapidityChart_measurePreserving 0).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (circularSmear_ae f)
29:   filter_upwards [orbitalL2Pullback_ae 0 (circularSmear f),hc] with y hp hc
30:   exact hp.trans hc
